thread_title: S. moorei extreme red throat improved 2.0
breadcrumb: S. moorei extreme red throat improved 2.0

posts.body_html:
here's a "newer" version of the moorei extreme red throat improved called "2.0" just to make the name sound nerdy and official. This is a different direction than the moorei extreme red throat improved, which took a more alata-esque turn with more white-ish coloration on the outside. This one sticks to the classic moorei shape and color overall but has a very well defined red throat and a little more color on the outside compared to the original moorei extreme red throat.

For reference, here's moorei extreme red throat: sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/4163/sarracenia-moorei-extreme-red-throat
and here's moorei extreme red throat improved, which sometimes can be a bit challenging to color up: sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/5254/moorei-extreme-red-throat-improved


These are still small seedlings and are being evaluated, so only time will tell what they'll look like as adults. S. moorei extreme red throat improved 2.0, pics taken 10/13/23:
